blocks.content: Quiz: Why do we update the cache directly in onSuccess instead of calling invalidateQueries?
Tap an option below to answer:
Because invalidateQueries only works with useQuery not useMutation
invalidateQueries works fine with mutations. That's its most common use case.
invalidateQueries works fine with mutations. That's its most common use case.
Because DummyJSON doesn't actually persist changes so refetching returns the original data
Correct. DummyJSON pretends to accept changes but doesn't save them. Refetching would undo everything.

Because setQueryData is always faster than invalidateQueries
Speed isn't the reason here. It's about what data DummyJSON actually returns.
